<!-- Feature PRs target `main`. Patch-fix PRs target the version-specific `hotfix/vX.Y.Z` branch. -->

## What

Describe the outcome this pull request delivers.

## Why

Describe the user problem or issue it addresses.

## References

Link related issues or decisions. Use `Closes #N` when this pull request completes an issue.

## Readiness

- [ ] Relevant tests are added or updated, or no new test is needed.
- [ ] The active versioned release-notes file has the appropriate line item, or no user-facing note is needed.
- [ ] Documentation, product demos, and marketing-site content are updated where relevant.
- [ ] For a patch fix, the fix is also being forward-ported to `main` without duplicating its note in the active minor release.
- [ ] Screenshots or video are included for visible UI changes where useful.
